Package com.workshop.mcp.spec.builders

Class AppToolBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.workshop.mcp.spec.builders.AppToolBuilder
public class AppToolBuilder extends Object
Builder for creating AppTool objects with a fluent API.

An AppTool is a regular MCP tool that additionally declares a _meta.ui.resourceUri, signalling to the host that an interactive HTML UI is available when this tool is called.

Example usage — building a keyword search tool with UI:


 AppTool tool = AppToolBuilder.builder()
     .withName("key_word_search")
     .withDescription("Searches for a keyword across all project files.")
     .withInputSchema(schema -> schema
         .withType("object")
         .addProperty(PropertySchemaBuilder.builder()
             .withKey("keyword")
             .withType("string")
             .withDescription("The keyword to search for")
             .required()))
     .withResourceUri("ui://keyword-search/mcp-app.html")
     .build();
Since:
1.0

    • withResourceUri

      public AppToolBuilder withResourceUri(String resourceUri)
      Sets the ui:// resource URI that points to the HTML app the host will render.

      The URI must use the ui:// scheme. The path is arbitrary — choose a structure that makes sense for your app, for example: ui://keyword-search/mcp-app.html.

      Parameters:
      resourceUri - the ui:// URI for the app's HTML resource
      Returns:
      this builder instance for method chaining

    • build

      public AppTool build()
      Builds and returns the configured AppTool.

      The resource URI is written under both _meta.ui.resourceUri and the flat _meta["ui/resourceUri"], matching what the reference MCP Apps extension puts on the wire.

      Returns:
      a new AppTool with the configured name, description, schema, and UI metadata
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if name, description, or resourceUri is missing
